Services

Glare, heat and moisture questions shape façade decisions from the first sketch to the permit. We offer two studies that answer them, scoped to sit within your work.

  • Sunlight

    Reflected glare

    Annual, receptor-based studies of reflections from façades and roofs, with results your team can use to compare glazing and geometry options.

  • Heat and moisture

    Thermal bridging and condensation

    Junction and wall assembly analysis, from early screening to detailed hygrothermal modelling, with results your team can use to compare detailing options.

How we work

We work as an extension of your team. Studies go out under your name or ours, your client stays yours, and each is fully documented so another engineer can pick it up.

  • Early design

    Option studies while glazing, geometry and detailing are still open, so the findings can shape the design.

  • Planning submission

    The assessment the planning authority requires, fully documented and ready to lodge with your application.

  • Peer review

    An independent check of an existing study’s inputs, method and results, with clear written comments.
